notes: The first them that is the article's own substantival rendering under rule 41, headed on the pronoun; an article morpheme is present, so rule 46 does not govern.
The second them, after seek, is added: אַל־תְּבַקְשׁוּ writes no object morpheme (rule 44).
nor goes to the waw alone, since both אַל particles already carry a written not of their own (rule 14).
